beckon.options.title: Beckon
beckon.options.enabled.tooltip: Turn every loot beam, label and despawn warning on or off.
beckon.options.mode.tooltip: Valuable Items: rare, enchanted, named items, tools, weapons and armor, plus everything on the Always Show list. All Items: every dropped item. Listed Items: only what is on the Always Show list. The lists are in config/beckon.json.
beckon.options.height.tooltip: How tall the beams are. Your own death drops get taller beams.
beckon.options.pulse.tooltip: Beams gently breathe brighter and dimmer.
beckon.options.ground.tooltip: A soft pool of colored light on the ground under each beam.
beckon.options.labels.tooltip: Show the name and count of the item you look at, or of one right next to you.
beckon.options.label_distance.tooltip: How far away an item you look at can be and still get a label.
beckon.options.blink.tooltip: Items blink, faster and faster, during their last 30 seconds before they disappear. On a server Beckon only knows how long an item has been around since you first saw it.
beckon.options.death.tooltip: The items you drop when you die get tall golden beams, so you can find them again.
beckon.options.merge.tooltip: Stacks of the same item lying close together share one beam, and the label shows the total.
beckon.options.reset.tooltip: Put every setting back to how it was when you installed Beckon.
